approvalReason.SCAM: Content flagged as a possible scam by Meta.
approvalReason.TAG_CONTENT_MISMATCH: The content does not match the chosen category.

reconcileUpdated: {count} template(s) updated from the provider's status.
reconcileNothing: No changes: statuses are already up to date with the provider.
syncPromptBody: You changed this template, but the provider still has the previous version: saving here does not update it automatically. To take effect there, the template must be resubmitted for review.
syncPromptWarn: Resubmitting sets the status back to "Under review" until the provider decides. Some providers limit edits to approved templates (Meta, for example: 1 per 24 hours, up to 10 in 30 days).
syncPromptLater: If you leave it for later, the template is flagged "Unsynced changes" and the provider keeps using the previous version.
outOfSyncHint: The provider still has the previous version. Use the send button to sync.
deleteSubmittedBody: This template was submitted to the provider ({connections}).
deleteRemoteHelp: Recommended. Removal on the provider is usually permanent and the template name may stay unavailable for a while (on Meta, about 30 days). If the provider refuses, nothing is deleted.
deleteLocalOnlyHelp: Unchecked: the template disappears only here and still exists on the provider, taking up quota.
categoryChangedBanner: The provider changed the category of {count} template(s). The system already follows its decision.
categoryChangedNote: Review usage: different categories have different pricing and consent rules (Marketing requires opt-in).
buttonsHelp: Up to 10 buttons. Actions (link, call, copy code) appear before quick replies.
buttonsEmpty: No buttons. Use "Add button" to include a link, phone, code or quick reply.
buttonsAuthFixed: Authentication templates use the provider's standard copy-code button; custom buttons do not apply to this category.
buttonUrlHelp: Button link. It may have one variable, only at the end of the URL.
buttonCopyCodeHelp: Copies the code sent in the message (e.g. a coupon) to the clipboard. Only one per template.
buttonQuickReplyHelp: The customer taps to reply with this text. Quick replies are grouped after the other buttons.
buttonErrUrl: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://.
buttonErrUrlVars: The URL accepts at most one variable, and only at the end.
buttonErrPhone: Enter a valid phone with country code, e.g. +55 11 99999-9999.
buttonsUnsupported: Interactive buttons are only available on connections that support them. The current connection sends the template as plain text. Set up a compatible connection in Settings to enable them.
buttonsUnsupportedExisting: No active connection sends interactive buttons. The buttons below were kept and remain saved; on connections without support they are sent as text (link and phone become "label: value", quick reply becomes text and "copy code" is not shown).
typeButtonsDescription: For devs: each button declared here becomes a typed key. The operator only picks the text in the template; a quick reply returns the key to the system when the customer taps, and the link uses the fixed base below.
reservedButtonsDescription: They already have built-in behavior in the system. Check the ones this template type may use.

button.opt_out: Stop receiving messages (flags the contact as opt-out)

buttonSlotUrlBaseHelp: The sending code provides only the end of the link, on each message. The base is set here and the operator cannot change it.
buttonSlotUrlBaseInvalid: Enter a full URL (http:// or https://) without variables.
buttonSlotSensitive: The end of the link is a token: mask it in the message history
buttonKeyInvalid: Use snake_case: lowercase letters, numbers and _
buttonKeyReserved: This name is a reserved system button
buttonKeyClashVariable: This key clashes with a type variable.
buttonHandlerHint: No code reacts to this key yet: the tap shows up only as text in the chat.
buttonSlotUrlHelp: System-controlled link: the base comes from the type and the end is provided on each send.
buttonSlotQuickReplyHelp: Type button: when tapped, the system receives the key and runs the associated action. Here you only choose the text.
templateBlockedSystemLink: This template has a system-controlled link ({names}) — it cannot be sent from the chat.
typeInUseCannotDelete: Cannot delete: this type is used by {count} template(s). Remove or change their type first.
typeChangeConfirmDescription: This type is used by {count} template(s). Those that no longer meet the new contract (variables or buttons) will be flagged "Needs adjustment" and cannot be sent or submitted until adjusted. Templates that remain valid are unchanged.
needsAdjustmentHelp: This template's type was changed. Adjust the text or buttons and save to allow sending again.
needsAdjustmentCannotSubmit: Adjust the template before submitting: its type was changed.
metaRulesErrorsHelp: The template can be saved, but submitting it for approval is blocked until fixed.
metaRulesWarningsTitle: Points that may lead Meta to reject or reclassify it:

metaRule.BODY_STARTS_WITH_VARIABLE: The body cannot start with a variable: write some text before it (e.g. "Hello, [name]").
metaRule.BODY_ENDS_WITH_VARIABLE: The body cannot end with a variable: add text after it (a period or a sentence).
metaRule.BODY_ADJACENT_VARIABLES: Two variables cannot be stuck together with no text between them: separate them with text.
metaRule.FOOTER_HAS_VARIABLE: The footer does not accept variables: remove the variable or move the text to the body.
metaRule.URL_SHORTENER: Shortened link ({host}) is rejected by Meta: use the full address of your own domain.
metaRule.BODY_TOO_MANY_VARIABLES: Few fixed words ({words}) for {variables} variable(s): Meta rejects text dominated by variables. Write more text or use fewer variables.
metaRule.UTILITY_WITHOUT_VARIABLES: A Utility template with no variables looks generic and is often reclassified as Marketing (different pricing).
metaRule.BODY_TOO_MANY_LINE_BREAKS: Many consecutive line breaks are often rejected by Meta: use at most one blank line.
metaRule.PHONE_WITHOUT_COUNTRY_CODE: The button phone must start with + and the country code (e.g. +55 11 99999-9999).

remoteTemplatesDescription: Existing templates in your WhatsApp Business account. Verify compatibility and link with local templates.
remoteTemplatesEmpty: No templates returned by Meta for this connection.
cannotDeleteSystemTemplateType: System template types cannot be deleted.
